image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister). The image focuses on the anterior portion of the crab, showing the broad, oval carapace with purplish-brown coloration and lighter mottling. Two stalked eyes protrude from the front margin. The large chelipeds (claws) are visible in the foreground, appearing robust with dark tips and serrated inner edges. The ventral surface is partially visible near the mouthparts, appearing cream-colored. The background is blurred, suggesting other crabs or a market setting.
